### New Integrations


- Added new ELD integrations:[24HOS ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/24hos-eld) ,[BST ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/bst-eld) ,[DIALOG ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/dialog-eld) ,[Ensi Log](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/ensi-eld) ,[Five ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/five-eld) ,[FleetVision](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/fleetvision) ,[Fortune ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/fortune-eld) ,[Hive ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/hive-eld) ,[Horizon ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/horizon-eld) ,[Hunter ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/hunter-eld) ,[Interstate Freeway](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/interstate-eld) ,[Logfleet](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/logfleet) ,[NEO ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/neo-eld) ,[Night Watch ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/night-watch-eld) ,[Orion ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/orion-eld) ,[Phantom ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/phantom-eld) ,[Remax ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/remax-eld) ,[Shelby ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/shelby-eld) ,[Smart eLog](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/smart-elog) ,[Sprint ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/sprint-eld) ,[Trendy ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/trendy-eld) ,[Trip ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/trip-eld) ,[Vector ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/vector-eld) , and[Wheels eLog](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/wheels-elog)


### Common Model Updates


- [Verizon Reveal](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/verizon-reveal) now maps registration numbers to[Vehicle](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle)` licensePlate.number`
- [Apollo ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/apollo-eld) now maps` PU` status to` personal_conveyance` in[HOS Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/hos-log)
- [Apollo Compass](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/apollo-compass) now includes latitude and longitude values in[HOS Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/hos-log) when available


### Integration Updates


- [Geotab](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/geotab) now applies g-force enrichment only to relevant harsh-driving and collision safety events


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now includes a PeopleNet provider setting to skip latest vehicle location enrichment for large fleets to improve performance
- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) has refreshed branding


### Documentation Updates


- Added a[Link Analytics Events guide](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/link-analytics-events) with event usage and implementation guidance
- Updated the[Duplicate Connections guide](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/duplicate-connections) to clarify how the Dashboard's Dedupe Connections setting affects connection creation
